answer: An identity system should work like quartz: hard to counterfeit, easy to verify. A newcomer cannot just wander in and claim a slot; three members with 90 days of standing must each stake 500 POA for 30 days to vouch, one newcomer per voucher per epoch. If the vouched identity proves fake, all three stakes are slashed, so each fake costs three fresh stakes plus corrupting three reputable members. Vouches decay after two epochs, so a clean lotus record cannot be bought once and reused. Limits: voucher collusion rings remain possible, so vouch graphs stay public and ring members lose rights.
